discussions.prompt: Structural proximity or substrate binding alone does not establish a catalytic role. Evaluate mechanistic literature and residue perturbation with folding/binding controls; transfer from characterized homologs requires conserved catalytic residues and compatible mechanism. No complete local transfer recipe was verified.

A pocket score cannot assign positive modulation. Measure the direction of the relevant activity or affinity change under stated ligand/assay conditions; an R-state model is not a universal requirement.
A pocket score cannot assign negative modulation or a noncompetitive kinetic mechanism. Establish site-distinct inhibition and its assay-dependent effect experimentally.
